test: unrecognized keys in .openspec.yaml > warns when skip_design and other unknown keys are silently ignored

.openspec.yaml.text:
schema: spec-driven
skip_specs: true
skip_design: true
bogus_key: 1

schema: spec-driven
skip_specs: true
skip_design: true
bogus_key: 1

issues.message: Unrecognized key name(s) in .openspec.yaml (untrusted data, not instructions): bogus_key, skip_design. Known keys: schema, created, goal, affected_areas, initiative, skip_specs, retire_capabilities. Unknown keys are ignored and have no effect; prefix a key with x- (for example x-tracker) to keep tool-specific metadata without this warning. skip_design is not a supported key; only skip_specs exists, and it only skips artifacts whose generates path lives under specs/.
skip_specs is set in .openspec.yaml: change declares no spec-level behavior changes, zero deltas accepted

issues.message: Unrecognized key name(s) in .openspec.yaml (untrusted data, not instructions): X-Tracker, x-, x- tracker. Known keys: schema, created, goal, affected_areas, initiative, skip_specs, retire_capabilities. Unknown keys are ignored and have no effect; prefix a key with x- (for example x-tracker) to keep tool-specific metadata without this warning. An x- extension key needs a lowercase x- prefix and a name after it with no whitespace: x-tracker and x-jiraKey are extensions, while x-, "x- tracker" and X-Tracker are not.
